title: 化学と安全
subtitle: Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety
keywords: Dangerous substances 2.Toxic substances 3.Hazardous materials 4.The PRTR law 5.Radioactive substances
educationalGoal: Experiments play a major role in chemistry education and research. The curriculum for this course places great importance on experimentation and laboratory work. Because chemical experiments often involve handling dangerous substances and equipment, serious injury can result from mistakes in handling, often caused by a lack of knowledge. This course will provide the knowledge needed to perform chemical experiments safely.
advice: 1. Introduction (fundamentals of safety, safety first, Heinrich's law) 2. Classification of dangerous chemical compounds (such as explosives, combustibles, RI) and their safe handling 3. Electric safety 4. Examples of serious accidents 5. Laws on dangerous chemical substances and their compliance obligations
requiredKnowledge: Having the qualifications for Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (Class A), a national qualification, is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Cite an example of an experimental accident and explain the cause.
Explain the dangers of hazardous materials, flammable gases, toxic substances, and other dangerous substances.
Classify chemical substances according to their risk category, such as dangerous, toxic, or deleterious.

achievementLevels.ideal: Can estimate risk, analyze the cause of accidents, and classify dangerous substances based on regulations without reference to books, dictionaries, or other reference materials.
